about:
Lower is better. Written by SITE_UX_RATCHET=write from target/site-ux/metrics (website/e2e/ratchet.spec.ts); one entry per docs task and gating viewport, light theme.
S-02, 2026-11-27: the tool fixes T3 (a control whose box runs past a box that clips it is judged by its text), T4 (a target taller than the viewport is in view when its top is) and T5 (a run that stops reports null, not 0) change what website/e2e/bot.ts measures; T2, T6 and T9 change the round report only. best-variant-of-author-reviewer is measured with the architecture in its frame (SUF-001) and the search result above it (SUF-002); trigger-block-lifecycle is new.

tolerances.counts: exact (0), for actions, looks, steers and glances
tolerances.steps: 5 % of the value, for time to act in steps and reading load in words
